name: Develop frame
description: A prompt box that dims the page while a picture develops from its darkest areas, then keeps each result in a strip of recent frames you can bring back.

default: A title writes itself on over a dark stage
Onion skins ghosting a hand drawn bouncing ball
Export the finished movie as a looping GIF
The same movie again in a bright light theme

default.alt: The FormMorpheus Stage showing a spinning gem and the word FORMAI, with the Timeline of tracks below
A FormMorpheus flipbook with a drawn gem, its onion skin ghosts and the frame strip below
FormMorpheus in Keyframe mode with motion paths on the Stage and ease lanes under the tracks
The FormMorpheus Export dialog offering Video, Animated GIF, Frames as images, Current frame and Sprite sheet
The FormMorpheus window in its light theme with the Stage above the Timeline

propDocs.prompts: Placeholder rotation, the idea buttons and the prompt used when the box is empty, in order.
propDocs.pictures: Array of {url, alt, re}. re is a keyword pattern; a prompt that matches picks that picture, otherwise the pictures rotate.
propDocs.matchOrder: Indexes into pictures, tried in this order when matching keywords.
propDocs.ratios: Array of [label, width over height]; the order matches the ratio buttons on the section.
propDocs.styles: Names of the three style buttons, in order: Soft, Crisp and Glow filters.

fallback: Without mix-blend-mode or filter support the frame plays a plain brighten-in instead of the threshold chain. Under reduced motion a frame appears at once and the page still dims for an instant.
